create_Batcher: create a Batcher instance with n_timesteps, n_slots, agent factory, env factory, n_threads, and seeds
execute_Batcher: execute the Batcher by calling execute to acquire slots across all worker threads
get_Batcher: get completed trajectory slots from the Batcher buffer with optional blocking behavior
reset_Batcher: reset all worker threads in the Batcher with new agent_info and env_info DictTensors
update_Batcher: update all worker threads in the Batcher by passing new info to each worker
